mapper.sql: FROM payment p JOIN student st ON st.id = p.student_id LEFT JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = p.order_id
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, p.student_id AS studentId, st.name AS studentName, o.order_no AS orderNo, p.amount, p.method, p.paid_at AS paidAt, op.name AS operatorName, p.voucher_no AS voucherNo, p.remark
JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = p.campus_id LEFT JOIN staff op ON op.id = p.operator_id
ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.paid_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS amount
AND p.paid_at >= #{from} AND p.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(p.paid_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
